Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly revised Langston Hughes’s tally from five occupations (poet, social activist, novelist, playwright, columnist) identified earlier to three (poet, writer, novelist), dropping roles without justification and conflating “writer.” Simultaneously, the Planner inflated Ian McEwan’s list by adding unconfirmed roles (e.g., essayist, librettist). This miscount led to the wrong conclusion; properly counted, Langston Hughes has more listed skills.
